product.name: Aurelio CoolMate 3000
product.description: The Aurelio CoolMate 3000 is a lightweight, portable cooling pad designed to keep laptops running smoothly during intensive tasks. Its dual‑fan system delivers a steady airflow of 120 CFM, while the adjustable fan speed allows users to customize cooling intensity. Constructed from heat‑resistant aluminum alloy and a soft silicone pad, the pad provides a stable surface and protects the laptop from scratches. A built‑in USB‑C power hub supplies up to 60W, enabling simultaneous charging of the laptop and peripheral devices. The matte black finish blends with any workspace, and the slim profile folds flat for easy transport. Ideal for gamers, designers, and professionals who demand reliable cooling on the go.
